partitions: Same selected pairs/modes and inherited0.1m/20% labels as raw protocol. Additionally partition all S2S bad-length entries from the complete original CSV (not final S2M entries) and bad interiors. Retain every boundary and every oracle length/vector failure; no chosen success subset.
rotation_metric: For offline angular reporting only, polar-project both stored rotation blocks to SO(3), then use atan2 of relative skew and trace. No projected rotation is fed to the solver or used for length/vector labels. Raw collection CSV angles used the trace formula on rounded GT rotations and can have a small nonzero floor even for an identical oracle seed; retain those original values, interpret the corrected report instead.
class_decomposition: At each recorded first linearization, H=sum H_c; g=sum g_c. Solve joint delta=-(H+1e-6I)^-1g and delta_c=-(H+1e-6I)^-1g_c. Verify sum(delta_c)=delta. Report the first-order current-sensor-origin displacement delta_v+delta_omega cross seed_translation, projected onto GT translation and divided by its length on moving cases. Contributions share the same total damped H; they are not independent per-class solves, term-deletion ablations, exact finite updates, post-update costs or repeated-association trajectories.
limits: Fixed-pair initial-condition intervention and first-system attribution only. Prior-mapped seeds come from the realized failing baseline, often already collapsed; a one-shot substitution cannot reject or validate a recursive predictor policy. Oracle GT is diagnostic, rounded and not guaranteed physically exact. No proposed solver/default/setting change, full-trajectory improvement, new paper ratio or complete correspondence-level cause. Stop reasons/last counts in alternate runs are unavailable from the existing API, not inferred.
